publicationBoundary: Every figure and every failure-mode fix is TypeSafe's own published documentation for jev-1.13, quoted, not measured by Anton. The 0.5 and 0.9 thresholds are TypeSafe's worked EXAMPLE and the card must say so (scale caption). 'Output not billed' is docs line 12921 ('Charged per input token. Output tokens are free.'). Supports 'this is what the vendor documents'; never 'this is how Jev performs on your data'.

sources.typesafe-docs: TypeSafe's published docs (docs.typesafe.ai, jev-1.13), mirrored verbatim at (private notes) Vendor-published, not independently verified.
